name: thread_cleaner
description: Automatically archives threads after a period of inactivity.

configFields.label: Enabled Channels
configFields.description: A comma-separated list of channel IDs where new threads should be tracked.

configFields.label: Inactivity Duration
configFields.description: The duration of inactivity before a thread is archived (e.g., '24h', '3d', '1w').

configFields.label: Cleanup Action
configFields.description: The action to perform on the thread after the duration.
